provenance.notes: Nothing here is published in a form that could be read on 2026-11-10: the API page (a Notion page) renders nothing without a browser, and https://odesli.co/terms redirects to a Google Drive document. The limits are unknown: the keyless access was limited to 10 requests a minute (the figure the API page gave and its clients repeat), and it is withdrawn - a call without a key answers 401 PUBLIC_API_ACCESS_DEPRECATED (seen by this package on 2026-10-03) -; the limit with a key is agreed with Odesli (developers@song.link), not published. Commercial use, caching, storage, redistribution and attribution are not stated anywhere readable: unknown, a site asks Odesli. The links Odesli gives open Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, YouTube and the others: their badge and logo rules are in omnisong's docs/policies.md.
